title: 第1526章 剑拔弩张第1525章 宴会开启
slug: 提前登陆游戏世界开局联姻女帝
content_zh:
“走吧，里面应该到了不少人了！”
玄霄开口对着极霸神子，云天，千骨寒说道。
极霸神子和云天两人都收敛了脸上的笑容神情变得极为严肃。
玄霄看了他俩一眼，自然明白这是为何？
这一次会议，极霸宗和云家绝对会是域外反对势力的主力。
因为他们手中都有各自的通道，他们绝对不可能关闭通道的，这件事已经涉及到了他们各自背后的根本利益，这也是为何一众天骄会在这个关键时刻选择出世。
“圣女，一起？”
玄霄目光又看向还在门口的太初圣女，不知这位圣女是在门口等人还是等他们？
而在太初圣女身后，太初圣地的一众人马都表情严肃时候，随时已准备好大战。
太初圣女看着玄霄点了点头，几方一同踏入山庄中，这在外界看来无疑是在释放某种信号。
“难道玄霄已经选择帮助域外？”
有人小声交流，有些诧异。
“玄霄本就是域外势力中的人，不帮助域外才奇怪吧。”
有人疑惑不解，于是人群中有人出声解释。
“玄霄虽然来自域外，但是他已经入主了南北天下的南大陆，他手下除了几位高层与他同样来自域外，但他真正根基都是第一祖地的本土人，可以说某种程度上，他代表的是第一祖地，
而且玄霄和他手下的几位高层都不排斥这种，他们也想要彻底融入第一祖地，因为他们出生虽然是域外，但是他们背后域外势力能够给他们的支持极为有限。
而玄霄手中目前也没有域外通道，所以一旦域外通道关闭，所谓此消彼长，那些域外第一梯队势力被削弱，玄霄与他们的差距便没有那么大了。
这站在玄霄自身利益角度来看，关闭域外通道其实是一件好事，所以他没必要反对才对呀！”
有人详细的说出这其中的逻辑，瞬间得到了很多认可，其他人也不禁说道。
“没错，这些域外天骄内部也并非铁桶一块，有一些域外天骄甚至巴不得这些通道被关闭，因为每多进来一人，这天下的资源便多了一个人竞争，这些域外通道只是对那些域外大势力有利罢了，而这天下资源总归是有数的，这些域外大势力占的多了，其他人得到的资源自然就少了……”

这个观点得到了很多人认可，在众人讨论声中，各方大势力接连进场。
太白神庭，鲲虚神庭也都出现了，还有几个隐世大宗，如天洛，林洛仙背后的势力。
月曦圣女，玄冥姬，玉昭圣女，龙女，清瑶公主这几位超凡界公认的仙子也先后出现。
吸引了很多目光。
“那是，靖玄神子，白泽神骑士，冷寂，千月……他们怎么都出来了？”
这次来的不仅有代表域外大势力的天骄，还有人孤身一人到达这里。
当人们看到这些人后都有些头皮发麻。
因为这几位，传说都是不败主，是各个时代当之无愧的第一人，上一次他们接连出现在一个地方还是五六年前，如今他们再次齐聚了。
“他们是被谁请动的？还是他们其实与那些域外大势力也有很深关系？”
有人疑惑，这次关闭域外通道是砍到域外大势力的大动脉啊！
这些不败主基本上都是孤身一人，手中又没有域外通道，为何这次也出现了？
难道来凑热闹？
带着这些不解，人们看到了从天边而来的蛮朝一行人。
而为首的那个人光彩夺目，身上有一股摄人的气息。
正是魔尊。
魔尊之后，世尊天尊也带着各自人马一同进入庄园中。
庄园外，众人面面相觑。
“会议还没开始，就已经有一股硝烟味了，这次不会真打起来吧，可惜咱们看不到里面的具体会议！”
有人遗憾的说道。
随着各路人马接连就进场，他们有预感，会议应该快开始了，但他们却遗憾无法进去现场观看。
content_en:
"Let's go, there should be a lot of people inside!"
Xuan Xiao opened his mouth and said to Ji Ba Shenzi, Yuntian and Qian Guhan.
Jiba Shenzi and Yuntian both suppressed the smiles on their faces and became extremely serious.
Xuan Xiao glanced at them and naturally understood why?
In this meeting, the Jiba Sect and the Yun Family will definitely be the main force of opposition forces outside the territory.
Because they all have their own channels in their hands, it is absolutely impossible for them to close the channels. This matter has already involved the fundamental interests behind them. This is why a group of geniuses chose to be born at this critical moment.
"Saint, together?"
Xuan Xiao looked at the Taichu Saint who was still at the door. I wonder if the Saint was waiting for someone at the door or waiting for them?
Behind the Saint of Taichu, all the people in the Holy Land of Taichu had serious expressions and were ready for a battle at any time.
The Saint of Taichu looked at Xuan Xiao and nodded, and they all stepped into the villa together. This was undoubtedly sending some kind of signal to the outside world.
"Has Xuan Xiao already chosen to help outside the territory?"
Someone whispered to each other, a little surprised.
"Xuan Xiao is originally from an outside force, so it would be strange if he doesn't help outside forces."
Some people were puzzled, so someone in the crowd spoke up to explain.
"Although Xuan Xiao comes from outside the territory, he has already taken over the Southern Continent of the Northern and Southern World. Except for a few of his senior officials who are also from outside the territory like him, his real roots are all natives of the first ancestral land. It can be said that to a certain extent, he represents the first ancestral land.
Moreover, Xuan Xiao and several of his senior officials do not reject this. They also want to completely integrate into the first ancestral land, because although they were born outside the territory, the support that the outside forces behind them can give them is extremely limited.
Xuan Xiao currently does not have an extraterritorial channel in his hands, so once the extraterritorial channel is closed, the so-called one will wax and wane, and those first echelon forces outside the territory will be weakened, and the gap between Xuan Xiao and them will not be that big.
From the perspective of Xuan Xiao's own interests, closing the extraterritorial channel is actually a good thing, so there is no need for him to object! "
Someone explained the logic in detail, and instantly received a lot of recognition, and others couldn't help but say it.
"That's right, these extraterritorial geniuses are not all made of iron. Some extraterritorial geniuses even wish that these passages would be closed, because for every extra person who comes in, there will be one more person competing for the world's resources. These extraterritorial passages are only beneficial to those big foreign powers, and there are always a lot of resources in this world. The more these big foreign powers have, the less resources others will get..."
This view was recognized by many people, and in the midst of public discussion, major forces from all parties entered the scene one after another.
Taibai Divine Court and Kunxu Divine Court also appeared, as well as several hidden sects, such as the forces behind Tianluo and Lin Luoxian.
Saintess Yuexi, Fairy Xuanming, Saintess Yuzhao, Dragon Girl, Princess Qingyao and other fairies recognized by the supernatural world also appeared one after another.
Attracted a lot of attention.
"That's, God Son Jingxuan, God Knight Bai Ze, Leng Ji, Qian Yue...why are they all out?"
This time, not only did the geniuses representing major forces from outside the region come here, but there were also people who arrived alone.
When people see these people, their scalps go numb.
Because these few people are said to be undefeated and the well-deserved number one in every era. The last time they appeared in the same place one after another was five or six years ago, and now they are together again.
"Who invited them? Or do they actually have deep relations with those big forces outside the region?"
Some people wonder that the closure of the extraterritorial channels this time is cutting off the main artery of the big extraterritorial forces!
These undefeated lords are basically alone and have no extraterritorial passages in their hands. Why did they appear this time?
Are you here to join in the fun?
With these puzzlements, people saw the Manchao group coming from the horizon.
And the one at the head is dazzling,There is an attractive aura about him.
It is the Demon Lord.
After the Demon Lord, the World-Honored Heavenly Lord also entered the manor with their respective troops.
Outside the manor, everyone looked at each other.
"The meeting has not even started yet, but there is already a smell of gunpowder smoke. There won't be a real fight this time. It's a pity that we can't see the specific meeting inside!"
Someone said regretfully.
As people from all walks of life entered the venue one after another, they had a hunch that the meeting would start soon, but they regretted that they could not go in to watch it live.
